senses.gloss: = h. עֲלִיָּה, upper chamber, loft; upper story.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Judges 3:23">Targ. Jud. III, 23</cite>, sq.; a. fr.—Constr. <cite ref="P00691"><he>עִילִית</he></cite>, <he>עִלִית</he>, <he>עֲלִיַת</he>, <he>עֲלִיַית</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Kings 23:12">Targ. II Kings XXIII, 12</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on II Samuel 19:1">Targ. II Sam. XIX, 1</cite>; a. e.—
<cite ref="Bava Metzia 14a:9">B. Mets. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>זבין עי׳ וכ׳</he> Ms. M. (ed. <he>עלי׳</he>) bought an upper story of his sister.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 99">Gen. R. s. 99</cite> <he>ע׳ קרירתא</he> the summer chamber (<cite ref="Judges 3:20">Jud. III, 20</cite>).
Pes. 114ᵃ, v. קָקוּלָא; a. fr.—ע׳ דדינרי a roomful of Denars, a certain amount of money.

<cite ref="Bava Batra 133b:6">B. Bath. 133ᵇ</cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="P00579"><he>עִילְיָן</he></cite>, <cite ref="P00579"><he>עִלְיָין</he></cite>; <cite ref="P00581"><he>עִילְיָתָא</he></cite>, <he>עֲלִיָתָא</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Jeremiah 22:14">Targ. Jer. XXII, 14</cite>.

<cite ref="Targum of II Chronicles 3:9">Targ. II Chr. III, 9</cite>; a. e.—B. Bath. l. c. <he>תליסר עִלְיָיאתָא דדינרי</he> thirteen roomfuls of Denars; <cite ref="Shabbat 119a:5">Sabb. 119ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="P00581"><he>עִילְיָתָא</he></cite>.
